import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, p, c, w;
        Edge(int v, int p, int c, int w) {
            this.v = v;
            this.p = p;
            this.c = c;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static class Mcmf {
        static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        static final int INF_CAP = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        static int n;
        static int[] vis, cur, dis, pot;

        static void initArrays(int size) {
            vis = new int[size];
            cur = new int[size];
            dis = new int[size];
            pot = new int[size];
        }

        static int addv(int c) {
            int old = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < c; ++i) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            n += c;
            if (vis == null || vis.length < n) {
                int newSize = Math.max(n, 10);
                vis = Arrays.copyOf(vis, newSize);
                cur = Arrays.copyOf(cur, newSize);
                dis = Arrays.copyOf(dis, newSize);
                pot = Arrays.copyOf(pot, newSize);
            }
            return old + c - 1;
        }

        static void adde(int u, int v, int c, int w) {
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), c, w));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, g.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -w));
        }

        static boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
            dis[s] = 0;
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] top = pq.poll();
                int du = top[0], u = top[1];
                if (vis[u] != 0) continue;
                vis[u] = 1;
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    int dv = du + pot[u] + e.w - pot[v];
                    if (e.c == 0 || vis[v] != 0 || dis[v] <= dv) continue;
                    pq.offer(new int[]{dv, v});
                    dis[v] = dv;
                }
            }
            return vis[t] != 0;
        }

        static boolean dinic_bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            vis[s] = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    if (vis[v] != 0 || e.c == 0) continue;
                    if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                    vis[v] = vis[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
            return vis[t] != 0;
        }

        static int dinic_dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
            if (u == t) return f;
            int sf = 0;
            for (int &i = cur[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
                int v = e.v;
                if (e.c == 0 || vis[v] != vis[u] + 1) continue;
                if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                int df = dinic_dfs(v, t, Math.min(e.c, f));
                sf += df;
                f -= df;
                e.c -= df;
                g.get(v).get(e.p).c += df;
                if (f == 0) break;
            }
            return sf;
        }

        static int[] mincostflow(int s, int t, int mf) {
            int sf = 0, sc = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
                int f = 0;
                while (dinic_bfs(s, t)) {
                    Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                    int df = dinic_dfs(s, t, mf);
                    mf -= df;
                    f += df;
                    if (mf == 0) break;
                }
                sf += f;
                sc += (dis[t] + pot[t]) * f;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) pot[i] += dis[i];
                if (mf == 0) break;
            }
            return new int[]{sf, sc};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int l = Math.max(n, k) * 2;
        Mcmf.g = new ArrayList<>();
        Mcmf.n = 0;
        Mcmf.addv(l * n);
        int s = Mcmf.addv(1);
        int t = Mcmf.addv(1);
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            Mcmf.adde(s, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 0; z < m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n, v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n, v2 = v + i * n;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    Mcmf.adde(u1, v1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    Mcmf.adde(v2, u2, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int from = j + i * n, to = j + (i + 1) * n;
                Mcmf.adde(from, to, Mcmf.INF_CAP, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < l; ++i) {
            Mcmf.adde(i * n, t, Mcmf.INF_CAP, 0);
        }
        int[] result = Mcmf.mincostflow(s, t, Mcmf.INF_CAP);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
